## Games

### Löwen Suffer First BBL Defeat of Season to MHP RIESEN

Basketball Löwen Braunschweig suffered their first loss of the easyCredit BBL season 2026/27, falling 98:107 to MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg in a thrilling match at the Volkswagen Halle. The game went into overtime, with the RIESEN ultimately emerging victorious. The visitors' sharp shooting from beyond the arc, hitting 47% of their three-point attempts, proved decisive. In contrast, the Löwen struggled from the perimeter, converting only 25% of their three-point shots. Gian Aydinoglu led the scoring for Ludwigsburg with a personal BBL best of 17 points. Löwen coach Ramón Díaz attributed the loss to a poor defensive start, allowing the RIESEN to build a nine-point lead after just five minutes. Aydinoglu's introduction sparked a Löwen resurgence, but they were ultimately unable to overcome the deficit. The loss leaves the Löwen with a 3-1 record and fourth place in the standings.

### SKYLINERS edge Veolia Towers Hamburg 89:78 in Frankfurt

The SKYLINERS secured a 89:78 win over Veolia Towers Hamburg in Frankfurt on October 11, 2026. Veolia Towers' David Muenkat led the team with a double-double, but it wasn't enough to overcome the SKYLINERS' offense. Veolia Towers' coach Benka Barloschky acknowledged that his team showed good fight, but ultimately lacked the physicality to take the win. Kenneth Ogbe also noted that the team struggled to stop the SKYLINERS' guards, and that they need to work on their three-point shooting and defensive rebounding. Meanwhile, Veolia Towers' Emil Marshall is set to return from injury and play against the SKYLINERS on October 11, after being cleared by the team's medical staff following a nine-week absence due to a blood clot in his leg.

### Niners Chemnitz secure second EuroCup win in Südtirol

Niners Chemnitz have secured their second win in the EuroCup, defeating their opponents in Südtirol. This victory marks the team's first away win of the season. Despite experiencing a weak phase, the Chemnitz team was able to celebrate their second win in the EuroCup. The team's performance was a significant improvement from their previous match, where they struggled before the break. In other news, RB Leipzig's women's team secured a historic win in the Bundesliga, defeating Mainz 05 with the highest score in the league's history in the second half.

### Rasta Vechta Suffers 64:96 Defeat in Basketball Champions League

Rasta Vechta played without four key players in the Basketball Champions League, including Power Forwards Philipp Herkenhoff and Lamin Sabally, and Point Guards Tommy Kuhse and Kihei Clark. The team suffered a 64:96 defeat against Serbian champions Spartak Office Shoes, who led by 25 points in the third quarter. Despite a 7:2 lead in the early minutes, Vechta struggled to keep up with the Serbians, who were more effective and physical. Vechta's Matt Lewis scored 12 points, while eight Spartak players scored eight or more points. The team will face ratiopharm ulm in the easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga on Saturday.

### Nelson Weidemann joins Rasta Vechta for Basketball Champions League Qualification

Rasta Vechta has strengthened its roster ahead of the Basketball Champions League Qualification tournament by signing Nelson Weidemann, a 27-year-old American guard who won the NCAA Championship with the Virginia Cavaliers in 2019. Weidemann, a double winner in 2024 with the German national team and FC Bayern München, will help the team compensate for the injuries of Lamin Sabally and D'Mitrik Trice. He has signed a three-month contract with an exit clause and is expected to be a valuable addition to the team. Weidemann is familiar with some of his new teammates, including Philipp and Tibor Pleiß, and is impressed with the training facilities and structures at Rasta Vechta. He aims to help the team win as many games as possible and be a difficult opponent for their opponents.

### Telekom Baskets Bonn Return to Champions League Action

The Telekom Baskets Bonn will begin their seventh season in the Basketball Champions League on October 7, 2026, when they host FC Porto at the Telekom Dome. The team won the Champions League title in 2023, becoming the first German team to do so. Fans attending the game will receive a free, limited-edition "Back To Champions League" T-shirt. The 32-team competition includes top European clubs, including title defender Rytas Vilnius, as well as German teams ALBA BERLIN, BMA365 Bamberg Baskets, and Telekom Baskets Bonn. The game starts at 8pm, with doors opening at 6pm. The team is also encouraging fans to participate in a T-shirt exchange at the game, with a limited number of shirts available for trade.

### Niners Chemnitz secure first away win in EuroCup

Niners Chemnitz secured their first away win of the season in the EuroCup, defeating Dolomiti Energia Trento 88-80 on the road. The team, led by coach Rodrigo Pastore, overcame a tough match with several lead changes and a high number of turnovers. Cobe Williams was the top scorer for Chemnitz with 30 points, including seven three-pointers. The win marks the team's second victory in the EuroCup and their first away win of the season. Chemnitz had previously struggled on the road, but this result gives them a much-needed boost in their campaign.

## Around the League

### Alba Berlin win first BCL home game of the season 90:79

Alba Berlin won their first BCL home game of the season against Igokea m:tel 90:79 in the Uber Arena. The game was initially evenly matched, but Alba Berlin took control in the final 10 minutes, securing the home win. Alba Berlin's coach Pedro Calles praised his team's performance, saying they had focused on rebounds due to Igokea's physical play. Igokea's coach Nenad Stefanović felt that his team had played well, but had given Alba Berlin's top scorer too much space, allowing them to hit three three-pointers. Alba Berlin's forward Joe Wieskamp credited his team's cohesion, saying they had stayed together and made the right decisions to win the game.

### Alba Berlin's Women's Team Starts Strong in BBL

Alba Berlin's women's team has had a strong start to the BBL season, with a 75:57 win over Herne on Saturday. ### Syntainics MBC Start with Big Win in ENBL Opener

Syntainics MBC began their new season in the ENBL with a convincing 106:84 victory over Bristol Flyers from England. The game, played in front of 1389 spectators in the Stadthalle Weißenfels, saw Kostja Mushidi top the scoring charts with 24 points. DeLonnie Hunt also impressed with 18 points, 6 rebounds, and 5 assists. The team shot 59% from the field and 46% from the three-point line, with all 12 players seeing action. Bristol, led by Davion Bailey with 32 points, kept pace with Syntainics in the first half, but the German team took control with a 10-0 run and a 32-point third quarter. Head coach Vladimir Jovanovic praised his team's performance, saying "We are the better team and we proved it on the court." Syntainics will next face two away games, first in the Netto BBL Pokal quarterfinals in Würzburg on Sunday and then in the ENBL against Lausanne three days later.

### Faschingswagen in Veitshöchheim vandalisiert mit Nazi-Parolen

The Veitshöchheimer Carneval Club (VCC) in Veitshöchheim, Germany has been vandalized with Nazi and anti-Semitic slogans on two of its Faschingswagen. The incident is the second of its kind in recent weeks, and the club's president, Marc-Nicolas Winter, is shocked and disappointed. The police are investigating the case, and the club has filed a complaint with the local authorities. The vandalism has caused significant damage to the Faschingswagen, which are used in the club's traditional Faschingszüge on November 11 and Rosenmontag. The club emphasizes that it is inclusive and welcomes people of all backgrounds, and Winter has distanced the club from the vandalism, stating that the club is 'for everyone - regardless of religion, origin, or skin color'.
